newsitem.title: USA: America's Coffee Cup in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: America's Coffee Cup in merger talks.

text.p: America's Coffee Cup Inc said it entered into merger discussions with a privately-held beverage company based in Denver.

Robert Marsik, president of America's Coffee Cup, said the the merger would significantly benefit both companies as their product lines are compatible, management teams complement one another and their distribution channels are the same.
Management of both companies are working out the details of a merger and expect a deal to be completed shortly.
Marsik said further details will be provided within a few days when a letter of intent is signed.
